prompts.title: Classic Suit and Shades

The subject is positioned slightly off-center, standing in a relaxed three-quarter profile with his body angled to the left while looking confidently into the distance. He has neatly styled hair, a calm, sophisticated expression.
Outfit: He is wearing a tailored black suit jacket over a crisp white dress shirt with the top buttons left open, revealing a subtle silver chain necklace. He accessorizes with round black sunglasses and a luxury stainless-steel wristwatch. His right hand is gently adjusting the shirt placket near the chest.
Background: A tree-lined park or urban garden with large trees and soft natural surroundings, rendered with a creamy bokeh background and no distracting elements.
Lighting: Natural daylight with soft directional sunlight filtering through the trees, creating gentle highlights on the hair and face with balanced contrast.
Camera Angle & Composition: Eye-level perspective, vertical medium portrait (waist-up), shallow depth of field, subject sharply in focus with a blurred background.
Style & Quality: Black-and-white photography, hyper-realistic, premium editorial fashion photography, ultra-sharp facial details, realistic skin texture, crisp tailoring, cinematic contrast, high dynamic range, 85mm lens, f/1.6, shallow depth of field, 8K resolution.

prompts.title: Azure Audiophile
prompts.prompt:

Composition: Medium waist-up portrait with strong subject isolation and centered framing. Subject fills most of the frame while maintaining soft negative space around the head and shoulders for a clean editorial composition. Aspect ratio 4:5.

Outfit & Accessories: Thick plain royal blue turtleneck sweater with rich texture, black trousers partially visible in the frame, a polished black analog wristwatch, glowing blue over-ear headphones with illuminated circular accents, and blue -tinted round metal-frame sunglasses reflecting studio light patterns.

Pose: Relaxed seated posture, leaning slightly forward with one arm resting naturally over the raised knee. Hands relaxed and natural. Casual yet confident body language.

Lighting: Soft directional studio lighting from the left side with a gentle Rembrandt-style pattern across the face, emphasizing skin texture and sweater detail. A blue practical glow emitted from the headphones creates subtle rim lighting around the ears and cheeks. Balanced highlights with soft cinematic shadows.

Camera Angle: eye-level for an intimate and engaging portrait feel.

Technical Details: Shot on an 85mm lens at f/1.8 for shallow depth of field and creamy background separation. Ultra-detailed skin texture, realistic fabric fibers, sharp reflections in the glasses, DSLR-quality clarity, cinematic color grading, photorealistic rendering, HDR, 8K ultra-resolution, sharp focus on the face and sunglasses.

prompts.title: Empower
prompts.prompt:
Create a sophisticated, high-contrast luxury studio portrait styled like a premium fashion magazine cover, based on the provided reference image of the subject.
Composition & Framing

Vertical 4:5 portrait orientation. The subject is seated centrally in the frame in a symmetrical composition, occupying roughly the central vertical third of the image. Large amounts of deep black negative space surround the subject, creating a dramatic editorial look similar to a high-end fashion advertisement. A minimalist studio environment fades smoothly into darkness with no visible background elements.
Subject & Pose

An adult man sits in a classic upholstered wingback armchair positioned in the center of the frame.
The chair is a muted brown or taupe color. It has a neutral, earthy tone with a matte fabric finish that subtly contrasts with the dark black background.

He leans slightly forward with a confident, composed posture that conveys authority and calm control.
His right hand is raised with the knuckles resting thoughtfully against his chin, creating a contemplative pose.

His left hand rests naturally on the chair's armrest.

His legs are relaxed and slightly apart, with both feet placed naturally on the floor.
The subject maintains a steady, intense gaze directly toward the camera, expressing quiet confidence and calm authority.
Attire & Styling

The man wears a monochromatic triple-black outfit:
tailored black blazer
black button-down shirt with the top button open
slim-fit black trousers
Footwear consists of polished black leather loafers worn without visible socks, exposing the ankles in a relaxed contemporary luxury style.
The overall wardrobe creates a refined black-on-black editorial aesthetic.
Typography / Magazine Style Element

At the top center of the frame, the word “EMPOWER” appears in a very large size, elegant high-fashion serif typeface similar to luxury magazine titles.
The typography uses:

high-contrast serif letterforms
thin hairline strokes with thick vertical stems
muted metallic champagne-gold / bronze color
The text is centered above the subject and integrated like a premium magazine cover title.
Lighting (Low-Key Editorial Lighting)

The scene uses dramatic low-key studio lighting.
A soft overhead key light or Rembrandt-style lighting illuminates the subject's face and upper body while allowing deep shadows to form around the chair and background.
Lighting highlights:

facial contours
hair texture
edges of the blazer
subtle reflections on the leather shoes
The floor lighting softly fades into black without strong reflections, producing a seamless cinematic fade into darkness.
Color Palette

Strict monochromatic tones dominated by charcoal, obsidian, and deep jet black, with the champagne-gold typography acting as the only contrasting color accent.
Texture & Detail

Ultra-high detail with visible textures including:
chair upholstery fabric
leather grain on the loafers
fine strands of hair
subtle skin texture
Shadows contain a slight cinematic film grain to avoid overly smooth digital rendering.
Face Matching & Identity Preservation (Important)
Strictly maintain high-fidelity facial structure and exact likeness from the person's reference image. Integrate the face naturally with the scene's lighting. Ensure realistic skin texture with visible pores and minor imperfections; absolutely avoid overly smooth AI skin or a pasted face-swap look.

prompts.title: Leading Man Aura
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic black-and-white cinematic studio portrait in 8K resolution, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
Reference & Identity (High Priority)

Use the uploaded reference image as the primary source of identity. Preserve the subject’s exact facial structure and likeness, including jawline shape, beard density (if present), hairstyle, skin tone interpretation in monochrome, eye shape, nose proportions, and natural skin texture.

Do not alter or beautify facial proportions. The final portrait must clearly resemble the same person.
Composition & Framing

Full-length seated portrait, centred in the frame.
Framing cuts slightly above the ankle rather than showing the complete figure.

The subject sits in a dark leather armchair, facing the camera directly, creating a strong, symmetrical composition.

Right leg crossed over the left knee, arms resting naturally on the chair’s armrests, shoulders upright and composed.

Maintain generous dark negative space around the subject.
Expression & Presence

Calm, serious, stoic expression with slightly narrowed eyes.

Direct eye contact with the camera, conveying authority, control, and quiet confidence.
Wardrobe

Classic formal evening attire:
tailored black tuxedo with satin peak lapels
crisp white dress shirt with black studs
black bow tie
tuxedo trousers
polished black Oxford shoes
Lighting

Dramatic cinematic top-down spotlight with strong directional light.

Low-key lighting with deep shadows, high contrast, and film-noir chiaroscuro.

Minimal or no fill light so the subject appears illuminated within a pool of light, fading into a charcoal-to-black vignette.
Style & Quality

Professional studio photography style with sharp detail, rich tonal contrast, and visible texture in leather, fabric, and facial hair.

Luxury film-noir editorial portrait aesthetic.
Negative Prompt

low quality, blur, soft focus, distorted face, altered facial structure, extra limbs, cropped head, cropped body, overexposed face, underexposed face, washed lighting, flat lighting.

prompts.title: Blueprint of Style
prompts.prompt: Studio commercial portrait, vertical poster 2:3, clean minimalism: one young man, fair skin, natural hair with a neat haircut, no beard or very well groomed, soft confident expression; he is sitting in a modern rounded designer armchair/soft lounge chair (bulky, sculptural shape), legs casually crossed, relaxed open pose; outfit in contemporary casual style: bright blue monochrome set (jacket and pants) or with subtle geometric accents, white socks and chunky light sneakers; background is a smooth seamless blue gradient (slightly darker at the top, lighter at the bottom), no text, no logos, no letters, no poster typography. Lighting: three-point studio setup, large soft key light (octabox/softbox) placed front-side and slightly above to model natural volume on face and clothing; gentle fill light or reflector on the opposite side with lower power to lift the shadows while keeping depth; subtle rim/back light from behind to create a clean outline along shoulders and hair and to separate the subject from the background; overall soft, controlled shadows, no harsh edges. Shadows and rendering: contact shadow under the chair and feet, very soft background shadow or gradient behind the subject, no dirty vignette; clean commercial retouch, realistic skin texture, moderate micro-contrast, high detail in fabric and sneakers, 4k, ultra sharp, photorealistic studio quality.
